title: SDK Field Kit — Labs Journal & Rapid Mentor Paths
content:
Purpose and audience
- Short: a compact, transportable set of guided labs and mentor prompts for early SDK adopters (internal advocates, solutions engineers, bootcamp mentors).
- Audience: solutions engineers running 30–90 minute sessions, developer advocates hosting office hours, and new eng teammates doing self-serve onboarding.

High-level goals (what success looks like)
- 30-minute lab -> working sample app that calls Redwood API, streams responses, and records token counts.
- Mentor path enables non-authoritative mentor to drive outcomes (a safe script + fallbacks).
- Minimal friction for multilang: JS + Python + (optional) Go snippets included.
- Telemetry: surface first-touch metrics (time-to-first-success, errors per route, average latency).

Field Kit components (compact)
- One-page "mission card": key commands, expected outputs, troubleshooting one-liners.
- 3 micro-labs: hello-gen (generate), chatify (chat + system prompts), embed-and-search (embeddings + rerank).
- Mentor script: short step-by-step with branching for common failures.
- Micro-checklist for hosts (network, key, region, CORS).
- Quick failover recipes: switch model, reduce tokens, enable streaming.

Micro-lab: hello-gen (30m)
- Objective: call Redwood text generation, stream and display tokens, show token cost breakdown.
- Steps: set REDWOOD_API_KEY, npm/pip install redwood-sdk-sample, run example, observe streaming.
- Success signal: terminal/app prints incremental tokens and final usage object.
- Common friction: API key not set, CORS, old SDK version. Mentor fallback: run curl example and paste response.

Mentor script (rapid)
- 0–3m: intro + set expectations -> "By the end you'll have a running sample that streams and shows cost."
- 3–10m: environment check (key, network) + run hello-gen. If fails, run curl, capture error, move to chatify.
- 10–25m: add a system prompt, demonstrate function/tool calling stub (if time).
- 25–30m: wrap, show telemetry dashboard link, ask for short feedback.

Telemetry & gating suggestions
- Emit event: lab_started, lab_completed, lab_failed_reason (string), time_to_first_success (ms).
- Surface in Console: cohort by quickstart version, error counts per route, top failure reasons from mentor notes.
- Privacy: do not log user prompt text by default — only hashed fingerprints + token counts.

Materials to produce (MVP)
- single-file mission card (PDF + printable)
- repo: /sdk-field-kit with 3 lang folders + README with one-liners
- short video (2–3 min) for mentors to run it once before sessions
- telemetry dashboard prototype (console view)

Open questions / TODOs
- Which SDK package name do we recommend in copy? (redwood vs redwood-sdk) -> ask SDK leads.
- Should we include a sandbox project with seeded data for embed-and-search? Pros: reproducible. Cons: maintenance.
- Multi-region quickswitch: list of allowed regions for customers on Dedicated.

Notes to self
- Keep language minimal and non-prescriptive for enterprise customers.
- Capture 3 short failure transcripts from first run for empathy doc.
- Reach out to @solutions-eng slack (#solutions-kits) for first pilot week (target: Feb wk1).

Appendix: Example curl sanity test (one-liner)
- curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -d '{"model":"redwood-1.4", "input":"hello"}' | jq .

Quick UX copy snippets (for mission card)
- Title: "30-minute SDK Field Kit — get to streaming + telemetry"
- Start button: "Run hello-gen"
- Error modal: "Connection failed — try region switch or curl test"

Quick experiment plan (pilot)
- Run 3 internal mentor sessions with solutions-eng volunteers. Capture: start->success time, top 2 friction points, suggested copy edits.
- Iterate mission card and push to /sdk-field-kit v0.2.

End.
